instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Titan Systems is a residential renovation and energy retrofit company specializing in deep energy upgrades like external insulation and heat pump installation. They handle approximately 80 projects annually, focusing on standardizing complex workflows such as automated grant application filing to improve operational throughput.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer developed an internal dashboard for order backlogs, but it lacked formal support and became abandoned after the developer left. The organization recognized that without institutional backing and formalized governance, promising ideas fail to scale into viable tools.
answers.strategicGoals: The board mandates a 500 basis point EBITDA improvement within three years, demanding disciplined cost driver analysis. Innovation must prioritize technology that demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual tasks, requiring clear ROI timelines under 12 months.
answers.additionalContext: New data localization requirements necessitate a full cloud infrastructure re-architecture within one year. Innovation efforts must sequence around this mandatory technical project or leverage the migration as a catalyst for modernization.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.

opportunities.title: Standardized Workflow Automation (Efficiency)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing tablet-based inspection and automated grant filing systems directly addresses the efficiency priority by eliminating manual data entry and reducing project overhead.

first_actions: Conduct vendor evaluation for a low-code workflow platform.
Pilot the new digital audit workflow on 5 high-volume projects.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in project lifecycle administration time by 30%.
milestones: Q2: Vendor selection complete and contract signed.
Q3: Pilot completion and ROI calculation finalized.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Predictive Cost Optimization Engine (Bold)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a sophisticated AI model trained on historical project data and real-time regulatory changes to predict material costs, compliance risk exposure, and optimal installation sequences.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated R&D sprint team focused solely on ML infrastructure.
Invest in specialized cloud computing resources for model training.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 10% reduction in material waste and regulatory compliance error rate.
milestones: Q4: Data pipeline established for historical project data.
Q2 Next Year: Initial predictive model deployment.

opportunities.title: Talent Upskilling for Digital Governance
opportunities.rationale: Address the talent barrier by creating a structured training path and mentorship program specifically focused on integrating new digital tools into existing operational roles, ensuring ideas gain institutional buy-in.

first_actions: Formalize a cross-functional task force for process improvement.
Implement monthly workshops focusing on system integration best practices.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Internal salary allocation for training time.
execution_plan.success_metric: 100% of core operational staff certified in new efficiency tools.
milestones: Q1: Task force formed and charter approved.
Q3 Next Year: Knowledge transfer milestones achieved across departments.

next_steps.action: Launch a structured vendor evaluation process for workflow automation and grant filing tools.
Form a formal 'Efficiency Task Force' to define the scope, budget, and KPI targets for the AI Predictive Engine R&D.
Initiate mandatory upskilling workshops focused on data governance and new system adoption for all key staff.

key_weaknesses: Reliance on informal processes which prevents scalable, repeatable innovation.
High dependency on key talent; lack of formalized knowledge transfer poses a significant risk during scaling.
Low digital maturity requires significant upfront investment in foundational systems rather than just surface-level tools.
